checked_sources.label: RA 9266 IRR Section 29 - Penal Clause
checked_sources.parent_article_quote: The stated penalty is a fine of at least PHP 100,000 and not more than PHP 5,000,000, imprisonment from six months up to six years, or both, at the court's discretion.

proposed.text: What penalties does RA 9266 impose for violation of its prohibitions?

options.text: A fine of not less than PHP 5,000 nor more than PHP 100,000, or imprisonment of not less than 6 months nor more than 6 years, or both.
A fine of not less than PHP 100,000 nor more than PHP 5,000,000, or imprisonment of not less than six months nor more than six years, or both, at the court's discretion.
Unlimited fines and mandatory life imprisonment, reflecting the severity of violations.
Only professional discipline such as suspension or revocation; no criminal fines or imprisonment.

rationale.a: The PHP 5,000-PHP 100,000 range is the common wrong answer; it is two orders of magnitude below the statutory minimum and is not the RA 9266 IRR Section 29 range.
rationale.c: The statute fixes a maximum fine of PHP 5,000,000 and a maximum imprisonment of six years; penalties are not unlimited.
rationale.d: RA 9266 imposes criminal penalties in addition to professional discipline; Section 29 is a penal clause, not merely a disciplinary rule.
rationale.correct: Section 29 of the RA 9266 IRR fixes the penal clause for unauthorized practice and other listed violations at a fine of not less than PHP 100,000 and not more than PHP 5,000,000, imprisonment from six months up to six years, or both, at the court's discretion. Section 30 separately penalizes forcing a registered architect to work without a written service agreement with a fine of at least PHP 200,000 and imprisonment not exceeding six years, or both.
rationale.takeaway: Read the RA 9266 penal clause in three buckets: (1) Section 29 unauthorized-practice penalty PHP 100,000-PHP 5,000,000 plus six months to six years; (2) Section 30 no-written-service-agreement misdemeanor (at least PHP 200,000, up to six years); (3) Section 23 professional discipline (suspension/revocation). Do not confuse criminal penalties with professional discipline, and do not memorize the outdated P5K-P100K figure.
